title: objectql roll-up folding follow-ups: bulk insert reads stored formula fields built on a folded roll-up; update fold on non-moving patches; trace the stand-downs
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ②: follow-ups of PR #34709 (Fixes #34465): two contract-review nits (comment 6943284591) and one out-of-scope finding from the dev report (6946193985). Dedupe: `bulk insert accumulator roll-up formula`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p2 · domain:server · bug · Blocked-by #34465

## Items

- Insert arm (finding): in the bulk-insert accumulator that landed with PR #34612 (#34466), the overlay patches only the roll-up summary field itself. A validation or trigger rule that reads a parent formula or stored computed field built on that roll-up still reads the stored value inside a bulk insert. This is the shape PR #34709 fixed on the predicate-update door (its L2 S1: recompute those fields over the folded values on the read path's own formula plan); the insert door needs the same.
- N3 — the update fold replaces the stored roll-up with a base aggregated from the children even for row 0 and when the patch touches no foreign key, source field or filter field of the roll-up. An update that cannot move the roll-up could keep the old path at zero cost; as written, a stale stored roll-up or a column-scale difference on `avg` / `sum` can make it answer differently from its by-id form.
- N4 — none of the three stand-downs leaves a trace; one debug line naming the roll-up left unfolded makes the published limit observable.
